inputs.text: The “betrayal of unity” story looks like theater. A public split between the US and China can make the withdrawal seem like a defeat for the deal’s architects, while the institutions behind the larger agenda keep their influence intact. The outrage may be part of the performance, designed to hide how much control remains in the same hands.
